## About
Jake Schaefer, Sr. was once known as the greatest billiards player in the world. During an exhibition in Dodge City, Kansas, Bat Masterson watched him play and called him a "Wizard" on the table. That nickname is the one on our sign.
Brothers Cooper and Willie Stewart set out to build not the biggest or fanciest sports bar and grille, just the best one. After running Wizards stores across Texas, they made the Richardson spot the best of all of them.
Come in for billiards, darts, games, live music and satellite sports, and stay for food that's always fresh and homestyle. Guests have given us a 4.2 rating from 1602 Google reviews.

## Services
- Billiards: 16 Gold Crown Brunswick billiards tables.
- Billiards league: Ask us about joining our billiards league.
- Skybox reservations: Reserve a private skybox for bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, business meetings or a night out with friends.
- Sports on TV: We show all the major sports, so your game is on.
- Live music: Bands play here. Check the Events / Bands page for who's coming up.
- Homestyle food: Always fresh, homestyle food, from wings and pizza to smoked brisket, sandwiches, tacos and salads.

## FAQ
Q: Can I smoke inside?
A: Cigars are allowed in the skyboxes only. The rest of the space is non smoking.

Q: Can I rent a room for a party?
A: Yes. Our skyboxes can be rented for bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, business meetings and nights out.

Q: Are there other games besides pool?
A: Yes. One reviewer mentioned games like Jenga and Connect 4.

## What customers say
- "Easily my favorite spot in Richardson. This place has plenty of pool tables, so even on busy nights you’re not stuck waiting forever to play. Stevo is the man behind the bar — he remembers all the regulars, keeps the drinks coming, and always has some entertaining stories if it’s a slower night. If he suggests a drink, just go with it. He turned me onto a tequila I’d never heard of that’s now my go-to.
The food is surprisingly good too. Everything I’ve tried has been solid. Overall it’s a great spot to watch the (Chiefs) games, shoot pool, throw some darts, or just hang out. Highly recommend." (Marahya Mora, 5/5)
- "Wizards is one of my favorite places to relax and hang out. The atmosphere is always fun, the drinks are great, and the staff make you feel welcome every time.

A special shoutout to Kayla—she is hands down the best server there! She’s always friendly, attentive, and has an amazing attitude. She makes sure everything is perfect and always provides outstanding customer service with a smile.

If you’re looking for a great bar with excellent service and a great vibe, I highly recommend Wizard. I’ll definitely keep coming back!" (Santon XP, 5/5)

Our waitress was super nice." (Lynn McGregor, 5/5)
